name: Crusader Kings III
notes: Every cheat needs the game hooked (press Hook). Console cheats also need Enable Console switched on: it sets the byte the game checks before opening its console, so no -debug_mode launch option is needed (it also turns on the game's debug tooltips while it is on). Using the console disables achievements for that save. Status: tested = confirmed working in CK3 1.20.1.1; parsed = accepted by the game's script parser (needs a DLC/government to observe); wiki = documented on the CK3 wiki; inferred = built from documented script values.

cheats.label: Enable Console
cheats.info: Lets you open the game's console (the ` key) without launching with -debug_mode. Needed for the console-based cheats below. It sets the game's debug flag, so debug tooltips appear while it is on; the original value is restored when you turn it off or unhook.

cheats.label: Set Money
cheats.info: Sets your gold. '+' mode adds instead (wiki-verified `gold <n>`).

cheats.label: Set Prestige
cheats.info: Sets your prestige. '+' mode uses `add_prestige`.

cheats.label: Set Piety
cheats.info: Sets your piety. '+' mode uses `add_piety`.

cheats.label: Set Renown
cheats.info: Dynasty prestige (renown). '+' mode uses `dynasty_prestige`.
cheats.set: effect dynasty = {{ add_dynasty_prestige = {{ value = {value} subtract = dynasty_prestige }} }}

cheats.label: Set Dread
cheats.info: Sets your dread (0-100).

cheats.label: Set Diplomacy
cheats.info: Sets your base Diplomacy skill.

cheats.label: Set Martial
cheats.info: Sets your base Martial skill.

cheats.label: Set Stewardship
cheats.info: Sets your base Stewardship skill.

cheats.label: Set Intrigue
cheats.info: Sets your base Intrigue skill.

cheats.label: Set Learning
cheats.info: Sets your base Learning skill.

cheats.label: Set Prowess
cheats.info: Sets your base Prowess skill.

cheats.label: Set King Age
cheats.info: Sets your character's age in years ('+' mode ages them by that many years). Skips birthday events.

cheats.label: Set Stress
cheats.info: Sets your stress points (0 removes stress).

cheats.label: Set Treasury
cheats.info: Treasury of an administrative/imperial realm. Needs the All Under Heaven DLC. '+' mode uses wiki-verified `change_treasury`.

cheats.label: Set Influence
cheats.info: Influence resource. Needs the Roads to Power DLC. '+' mode uses wiki-verified `add_influence`.

cheats.label: Instant Construction
cheats.info: Finishes constructions instantly and reinforces men-at-arms at once. The game's `instabuild` command is a toggle itself.

cheats.label: Fast Culture Progress
cheats.info: Every 20 s discovers the innovations of your culture's current era (`discover_era`). Far faster than vanilla.

cheats.label: Instant Movement
cheats.info: Armies move one barony per day. Affects the AI too. The game gives no 'off' command; typing it again may not undo it, restart the game to clear.

cheats.label: Max County Control
cheats.info: Every 15 s sets control of all your counties to the maximum.

cheats.label: Freeze Time
cheats.info: Keeps the game paused, even if you press Space or click play. Needs the game to be hooked (press Hook). Event pop-ups still pause the game by themselves.
